subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The patient / look / a little more cheerful / this morning.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is "look."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part** "look."**
 
• The error is in the use of the subject-verb agreement.
 
• The verb** "look"** should be conjugated to match the third-person singular pronoun **"patient,"** resulting in **"looks"** instead of **"look."**
 
• The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The patient **looks**__ a little more cheerful this morning.*
